li.p: Stop the vehicle and open the passenger’s door with the EV button in the POWER ON position and the vehicle shifted to P (Park).
Adjust the passenger’s seat and seatback to the foremost position.
Press the passenger’s seat movement switch (reclining, cushion height) forward over 2 seconds simultaneously.

note.p: Make sure there are no obstacles around the driver’s seat before initialization.

li.p: The initialization process is as follows.
The forward/backward position, seatback angle, height adjustment, and cushion tilt operate in sequence.
After all operations, initialization is complete.

section.title: Non-operating conditions
section.p: The initialization process will be interrupted in the following situations.

li.p: When shifting out of the P (Park) position into another position
When the passenger’s side seat adjustment switch is pressed
When the vehicle speed is above 5 km/h (3 mph)
When the passenger’s side door is closed

section.p: If the passenger’s seat operation stop during initialization, start initialization again.
After initialization, adjust the seat to suit the passenger.
